deployments_detail.use: GaiA — generative AI platform optimized for semiconductor manufacturing & R&D; AI agents, "AI floor manager"; Yongin fully-automated AI fab by 2027

IVIA (Intelligent Visual Inspection Analytics) — deep-learning system that automatically detects and classifies wafer/chip defects, replacing manual visual inspection in DRAM/NAND production. [In-house (SK Hynix Data Science org)]
deployments_detail.value: Reduced repetitive manual inspection work by more than 90% (source article); ~75% of quality inspectors' work automated (per SK hynix DX article)

deployments_detail.use: Sherlock — ML model that predicts memory-chip quality scores at the module-assembly stage using individual wafer test results, guiding binning/quality decisions. [In-house (SK Hynix Data Science org)]

AI-based equipment abnormality detection and control across fab tools — monitors sensor/process data in real time to detect equipment anomalies and enable root-cause analysis (~3x faster than manual methods). [In-house]
deployments_detail.value: Anomaly detection and cause analysis sped up ~3x vs prior methods (source: 'sped up the time for anomaly detection and cause analysis by three times')

deployments_detail.use: Gauss Labs Panoptes Virtual Metrology — AI predicts wafer process outcomes from process- and wafer-state data to enable virtual metrology, process control and yield optimization; deployed in SK Hynix fabs (SK Hynix listed as customer). [Gauss Labs (SK Hynix / SK Group industrial-AI subsidiary)]

Gauss Labs Panoptes Image Metrology — AI pipeline that analyzes metrology images to measure process outcomes with consistency/repeatability, reducing manual measurement work; deployed with SK Hynix (co-presented at SPIE AL 2024). [Gauss Labs (SK Hynix subsidiary)]
Multi-year Nvidia partnership to use digital twins and 'autonomous fab' AI/physics tools (GPU-accelerated simulation) for semiconductor manufacturing operations. [Nvidia (autonomous fab tools)]
AI-driven facility/utility operation optimization to reduce energy costs across fab infrastructure operations. [In-house]
Robotic Process Automation (RPA) / AI bots running continuously across manufacturing, R&D and purchasing divisions to eliminate repetitive manual back-office tasks. [In-house]

Adoption of external generative AI (including ChatGPT) as internal work/productivity tools for employees, framed as accelerating AI use for competitiveness (following Samsung Electronics). [OpenAI (ChatGPT) and other external AI models]

Internal AI/analytics platforms: DAY (Design Analytics Yourself) common analytics/model-development environment and AIP (AI Service Platform) for operating and managing deployed AI models at fab scale. Supports 300+ active AI projects. [In-house]
deployments_detail.value: More than 300 projects underway across company-wide and seven Domain DS Teams (source-confirmed)
